I can’t reliably determine all the numeric values by hand from this sequence, so I won’t invent an answer line. The final assignment does establish that `TMP` and `h` have the same value.

This script will execute the assignments and print the requested line. Save the assignment text to `assignments.txt`, then run it with `python solve.py < assignments.txt`:

```python
import re
import sys

values = {}
text = sys.stdin.read()

for name, source in re.findall(
    r"(?m)^\s*(TMP|[a-p])\s*<-\s*(TMP|[a-p]|\d+)\s*;", text
):
    values[name] = int(source) if source.isdigit() else values[source]

names = list("abcdefghijklmnop") + ["TMP"]
print("ANSWER: " + " ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]};" for name in names))
```
